Mfa._comment: The methods a person may enable: the authenticator alone unless set; add "email" to open the code by e-mail, which proves no second factor.

EmailVerification._comment: The least time between two codes to one address; asked sooner, nothing is sent and the page says the same. 00:00:00 for none.

PasswordReset._comment: The least time between two reset links to one account, the same way.

Pages._comment: GravatarImport is off unless set: the example turns it on to show it.

RateLimiting._comment: What the pages refuse as too fast, whatever the host set up: the POSTs of one client address, and the POSTs naming one e-mail, over a sliding window. Enabled unless set to false.

Session._comment: How long a signed-in session goes before its account is read again; 00:00:00 reads it on every request.
